author: Zintenka
body:
Haven't made a map in a century for you guys. Well, the post that I made called: "Great Map Tools", most of the stuff... if not all of them were used here. So sit back and enjoy Papa Zintenka's terraformin' niche and ambitiousn- uh i mean "persistent beauty!"


"Now we got villager trades to work, how 'bout developing a syntax that lets players keep their inventory?"
- Zintenka, 2015

Authors:
  • Zintenka

Features:
  • 40v40 (Saw a map that had this player amount. I am bringin' back more maps with this player amount so more players can enjoy gratuitous warfare)
  • 4 monuments (Guarded by layers of obsidian with beacons that give Haste) 
  • Villager trading
  • Mob spawners (There is an underground one that spawns zombies in armor holding gold nuggets, Kill them, and get nuggets. There is also two mob spawners in center that WILL spawn 6 wither skeletons in full diamond armor; they are holding 32 nether bricks with a 50-40% chance of getting their armor)
  • Item spawners (Gold nugget farm in front of spawn. Craps gold nuggets like a guy who ate laxative pills xD)
  • Donations Chests (Feel like bein' a team player? Put anything bought from the store into these and have players rummage through 'em and pick out things. Whether currency or items!)

Currency System:
Nether bricks are the mainstay of the shop's currency, however, gold nuggets and blocks are used to get nether bricks. Head to the "Currency" villager and get access to money!

Mob spawners:
Head underground to get free  nuggets and fight the "Free Nugget" Zombos to get 'em! 


Or fight the ravenous "Berserkers" above armed with full dia and who have the intent to slap money (Nether bricks) across your face - literally! There are a lot of them and they are as vicious as they are rich! I mean, anyone who wishes to whack you with money must be right?



Kill them to get their money with a 40-50% chance of getting their armor too!

YAML

Download

Imgur

Bon apetite,  ungrateful fat as-- I mean, slightly conceited portly peop-- Uh! I mean um, very nice people. *Nervous chuckle*

Please note: The offhanded commentaries are just jokes :3
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Changelog v1.0
  • Updated YML
  • New download, old one was set to "Peaceful" so mobs from spawners didnt spawn.
Changelog v1.1
  • Updated download and YML to hopefully get villagers working.
  • Set map to night time.

I know its big, but I made sure that it isnt that big and it isnt wide. 
I also made sure the objectives were more to the front as well. Plus void-buid: false is in play so no U-bridges :)
Plus a height limit at Y-100 so combat should not be so open and it should be more focused at one area.

Thanks for the feedback Robby :D
